space: glTF 2.0 (Y up, character faces +Z). joint_offsets = node-LOCAL translation delta per +1.0 slider (add s*delta to the rest translation); rot_offsets = node-local quaternion [x,y,z,w] at s=1 (post-multiply slerp(identity,q,s) after the clip is sampled).

sliders.name: height
sliders.desc: v4: body below the chin +-25% (z; x/y +-10%), feet on the floor; the head is never scaled, it rides up

sliders.name: head_scale
sliders.desc: v4: head +-35% about the chin (chin stays on the shoulder plane); replaces head_size

sliders.name: leg_length
sliders.desc: legs stretched between ankle and hip joint: +-30% leg length; everything above rides up

sliders.name: arm_length
sliders.desc: upper+lower arm stretched shoulder->wrist: +-35%; hands ride out

sliders.name: torso_length
sliders.desc: waist->armpit stretch: +-25% of that span; arms/neck/head ride up

sliders.name: shoulder_width
sliders.desc: upper chest widens up to 4 cm/side, arms shift out 4 cm/side

sliders.name: hip_width
sliders.desc: v4: hips/pelvis +-25% wide below the waist; legs ride out

sliders.name: torso_leg_split
sliders.desc: v4: +1 = legs 20% longer and the torso shorter by the same amount (chin height fixed)

sliders.name: limb_girth
sliders.desc: v4: arm+leg girth +-35% radial, hands +-25%, limbs shift out 1.0-1.2 cm/side

sliders.name: limb_taper
sliders.desc: v4: +1 = limbs 30% thicker at the root and 30% thinner at the wrist/ankle

sliders.name: build_bulk
sliders.desc: thin<->stocky: torso +-30% (x,y about the spine axis), limbs +-35% radial about the limb axis; arms/legs shift out with the torso

sliders.name: belly
sliders.desc: front belly bulge up to 4.5 cm, centred at z 0.47

sliders.name: hunch
sliders.desc: forward spine/neck curve (rotation offsets: Spine 14, Chest 10, Neck 12, Head -24 deg so the face stays forward)

sliders.name: hand_size
sliders.desc: hands scaled about the wrist: +-50%

sliders.name: foot_size
sliders.desc: feet scaled in length/width about the ankle: +-45% (sole stays on the floor)

sliders.name: neck_thickness
sliders.desc: neck +-50% radial

sliders.name: jaw_width
sliders.desc: lower face/jaw wider (+30% at the chin, fading out by the cheekbones) and slightly forward

sliders.name: gut
sliders.desc: refs1: big round gut (FF3 Djinn): front +6 cm, sides +2.2 cm, back +0.8 cm, peak at the navel (z 0.465); garments hang straight below the peak

sliders.name: chest_barrel
sliders.desc: refs1: barrel chest / deep ribcage: front +3 cm, sides and back +1.4 cm, peak z 0.60

sliders.name: arm_thickness
sliders.desc: refs1: arm girth +-40% radial about the arm axis, arms shift out 1.5 cm/side (joints)

sliders.name: leg_thickness
sliders.desc: refs1: leg girth +-35% radial about the leg axis, legs shift out 1.2 cm/side (joints)

sliders.name: neck_length
sliders.desc: refs1: neck length +-55% of the neck joint span (head rides up/down); negative = the stocky FF3 "no neck"

sliders.name: stoop
sliders.desc: refs1: elder stoop (rotation offsets: Spine 8, Chest 16, Neck 14, Head -26 deg; clavicles rolled forward 12 deg = rounded shoulders)

sliders.name: body_type
sliders.desc: 0 = male base, 1 = female (continuous): shoulders -1.4 cm/side, neck -15%, jaw -7%, hands/feet slightly smaller, thighs +6 mm apart (joints); waist in, hips out, modest smooth bust, arms 2.8 mm slimmer (morph). Garments carry a drape variant of the same key.

params.name: face_eye_spacing
params.desc: eyes (+brows) slide apart/together along the head surface: +-10 mm each (v5; v4 was +-6)

params.name: face_eye_size
params.desc: eye quads scale about their centre: +-35% (v5; v4 +-20%)

params.name: face_eye_tilt
params.desc: outer eye corners up (+) / down: +-12 deg

params.name: face_mouth_curve
params.desc: mouth corners bend up (+, smile) / down (-) along the surface: +-4 mm at the art corners

params.name: face_nose_length
params.desc: nose length: drawn = bridge height +-35%; mesh = protrusion +-40% and bridge +-20%

params.name: face_brow_size
params.desc: brow quads scale about their centre: +-30% (v5)

params.name: face_brow_tilt
params.desc: outer brow ends up (+, stern) / down (-, worried): +-15 deg (v5)

params.name: face_mouth_size
params.desc: mouth quad scales uniformly about its centre: +-30% (v5)

params.name: face_scale
params.desc: whole feature group (eyes, brows, mouth, nose) scales about the face centre: +-20% (v5; UI small/std/large = -0.8/0/+0.6)

materials.M_Eye: eyes: offset (0.25*frame, shape/12) on the 192x576 eye strip
materials.M_Brow: brows (Body_brow_L/R, v5): offset (0.25*eyeFrame, brow/8) on the 192x192 brow strip
materials.M_Mouth: offset (0.25*frame, mouth_style/10) on the 192x320 mouth strip

face.note: feature quads are separate nodes skinned 100% to Head (race head_size/jaw_width morphs move them with the head); face_* morph weights -1..1 exist only on the feature meshes; nose: show exactly ONE of Body_nose (type drawn, variant via M_Nose offset) or Body_nosem_<variant> (type mesh, skin-textured M_Body); hide a node to suppress a feature (bandana mask hides the mouth and every nose node) | v5: bigger default features (eyes x1.25, brows x1.2 raised 3.5 mm, mouth x1.15), brows on their own material M_Brow, face_scale moves the whole group

v5.colours: textures/face_v5.json (iris ramps, sclera tints, masks: recolour rule scripts/faces_v5.py recolor)
v5.recipe: face.{eyeColor,sclera,browColor("hair"|[set,name]),paint{blush,freckles},v:5}; missing keys -> slate / white / hair / none; v<5 recipes rescale face_eye_spacing*0.6, face_eye_height*0.7, face_eye_size*0.571 (same mm as v4)

face.snoutNote: 'snout' (firbolg) is appended LAST and is never drawn by the generic random nose pick (pick range = noseRandomCount), so other races' faces never change
face.mouseNote: 'mouse' (mousefolk muzzle) is appended LAST after 'snout' and never drawn by the generic random nose pick
face.koboldNote: 'kobold' (kobold snout) is appended LAST after 'mouse' and never drawn by the generic random nose pick
face.dragonNote: 'dragon' (dragonborn snout) is appended LAST after 'kobold' and never drawn by the generic random nose pick

ear_long.name: ear_long
ear_long.desc: pointed ear -> long goblin ear (tip out/back, only on Body_ears_pointed)

runtime: keep only rotation tracks + the Hips translation track of each clip (drop other translation/scale tracks)
every frame: reset bones to rest TRS -> sample clip -> for each bone: t += sum(s*joint_offsets); Hips: t = rest + (t_anim-rest)*(1+sum(s*hips_motion_scale)) + sum(s*joint_offsets)
then q = q * slerp(identity, rot_offsets, s) for rotational sliders; morph weights = slider values (negative weights allowed); ears: toggle Body_ears_pointed visibility, ear_long morph
body_version: v4 (overhaul P1): 3.03 heads, flat shoulder plane, tube arms, mitten hands, one canonical 24-bone rig

optional_bones.note: shared rig 24->29 joints: unused, non-deforming for races without a tail / wings (no vertex weights on them outside Tail_* nodes); Idle/Walk clips have no tracks on them. Tail sway is code (tail block).

horns.raceMorphs: every body race slider morph is baked on the horn meshes so they ride the head

tail.dye: region 1 = skin ramp, region 2 = hair ramp (tuft / tip)
tail.note: Tail_1 parented to Hips; code-driven (see viewer tfPose); Idle and Walk clips unchanged

bandana.fitMorphs: hf_<shape>(_low) at horn_size 0, hf_<shape>(_low)_1 at +1; weights (1-s,s) for s>=0, (1,0) for s<0

plumed_hat.fitMorphs: hf_<shape>(_low) at horn_size 0, hf_<shape>(_low)_1 at +1; weights (1-s,s) for s>=0, (1,0) for s<0

straw_hat.fitMorphs: hf_<shape>(_low) at horn_size 0, hf_<shape>(_low)_1 at +1; weights (1-s,s) for s>=0, (1,0) for s<0

turban.fitMorphs: hf_<shape>(_low) at horn_size 0, hf_<shape>(_low)_1 at +1; weights (1-s,s) for s>=0, (1,0) for s<0

cap.fitMorphs: hf_<shape>(_low) at horn_size 0, hf_<shape>(_low)_1 at +1; weights (1-s,s) for s>=0, (1,0) for s<0

hornRule.helm_horned: its own horn meshes switch off when the character shows horns

glow_eye.mask: eye strip class 2 (iris) + 5 (pupil) -> unlit, outside the 4 pixel-lighting bands, not darkened by the hood face shade
glow_eye.unity: material keyword TB_GLOW_EYE: albedo passes straight through where the glow mask is set (emissive = albedo, no band ramp)

hood_beard.when: hood wear=up AND a facial_hair asset other than mustache is visible; weight 1
hood_beard.note: hood lower-front/chin rim cut back behind the beard and raised ~1 cm around the jaw; beard pushed forward over the rim (<=1 cm) at every hood depth and beardLength

great_elf.note: LEFT figure of great_elf_evolution.jpg only (tall, slender, grey, slightly larger eyes); the right figure is lore only and is never built

mousefolk.base: tiny (pixie) tier: races/size_tiers.json, big round head

pixie.base: tiny (pixie) tier: races/size_tiers.json (+0.15 head_scale), slender, pointed ears, big eyes

kobold.base: 'small' size tier (races/size_tiers.json): halfling height, chibi head

dragonborn.base: 'large' size tier (races/size_tiers.json): human height or a bit taller, broad, thick neck

morphs.ear_elf: long upswept elven ear (tip out / up / back), weight = recipe face.ear_elf 0..1
morphs.ear_elf_low: corrective with st_ears_under_hat: ear swept back flat under a brim; weight = ear_elf when earRule is low

elfEars.data: garments/el/el_data.json earMorphs (sparse {i: vertex indices, d: flat xyz deltas, glTF metres})

earRule.appliesWhen: face.ear_elf > 0 (other races keep the manifest rule hat_folds_pointed_ears)

morphs.ear_bolg: wide drooping cow-like firbolg ear (tip out / down, front-back spread), weight = recipe face.ear_bolg 0..1
morphs.ear_bolg_low: corrective with st_ears_under_hat: ear tucked down flat under a brim; weight = ear_bolg when earRule is low

gfEars.earRule: same table / order as earRule (elves); applies when face.ear_bolg > 0

gfPaint.recipe: face.paint.lith / snout / speckle 0|1 (+ <k>Col), emitted only when set

mfEars.material: M_MouseEar (region 1 fur = skin ramp, region 2 inner = pink ramp)

morphs.mouse_ear_low: 1 when earRule is low (folded back flat under a brim)

mfEars.recipe: face.ear_mouse 0..1 (0 = no mouse ears); emitted only when > 0

mfMuzzle.whiskers: Body_whiskers_mouse (visible exactly when the muzzle is)

sizeTiers.note: Per-race root scale: set the character Root bone (or the prefab root) localScale = tiers[race tier].scale; collider / camera / nav agent heights scale with it. Presets already carry the tier body sliders.

pxWings.material: M_PixieWing (alpha MASK 0.5, double-sided; mask region 1 = wing dye ramp)
pxWings.shapeUV: texture u offset = shapeIndex / 5 (each card spans one 64x64 cell)
pxWings.lit: emissive = 0.45 x base colour so the membrane does not band harshly
pxWings.backSlot: cape (Back slot) + SOCK_back props hidden while wings are on
pxWings.recipe: px {wings 0|1, shape, size -1..1, color} (emitted only for races with wings)

clips.flapLayer: WingFlap (Wing_L / Wing_R only; override layer or second mixer action)

params._note: clip parameters (scripts/px_glb.py bakes them into Hover / FlyMove / WingFlap; Unity plays the same clips: base layer Hover or FlyMove, WingFlap on an override layer masked to Wing_L / Wing_R). Angles in degrees, world axes (+Z forward). lift / bob in Hips units before the Root tier scale (x0.56).

pxFlight.note: Hover lifts Hips (about 0.12 m at the tiny tier) with smooth bobs; keep the ground shadow / collider on the floor. Other races never play these clips.

kbSnout.uv: front-projected onto the face atlas (TEXCOORD_0/1 = the face texels under it), nostrils + mouth line = facepaint_kface
kbSnout.morphs: the 28 face_nose_* / nose targets ridge-fitted like the firbolg snout
kbSnout.mouth: hide Body_mouth while the snout is visible

kbTail.material: M_KoboldTail (region 1 scales = skin ramp, region 2 belly strip = belly ramp: skin stop 0 x 0.60 + [236, 206, 120] x 0.40)
kbTail.hem: hidden under floor-length capes / robes (same rule as every tail)

kbHorns.note: shared tiefling horn system (Horn_<shape> + Horn_<shape>_low, hornfit hf_<shape>, hornRule show / low / hide); recipe tf.horns; null = no horns

dbSnout.uv: front-projected onto the face atlas (TEXCOORD_0/1 = the face texels under it), nostrils + mouth line = facepaint_dface
dbSnout.morphs: face_nose_length / face_nose_width / face_nose_height = length / width / droop (ridge fit of Body_nosem_broad, damped 0.45)
dbSnout.mouth: hide Body_mouth while the snout is visible
dbSnout.hood: G_hood_up morph 'db_snout' = 1 while the snout shows

dbCrest.zone: crown (hidden by hoods / helms / hats / bandana like any crown part; sth_crest_db_flat under hats)
dbCrest.rule: dragonborn: every other hair part + facial hair hidden; the crest is the hair

dbTail.material: M_KoboldTail (region 1 scales = skin ramp, region 2 belly strip = dragonborn belly ramp)

child.formula: effective slider = clamp(keep[s]*S[s] + add[s], min, max) (keep default 1, add default 0); face param = clamp(faceKeep*p + faceAdd, -1, 1); Root bone uniform scale *= race.scale (after the size tier scale). Same rig/bones; recipe S stays the adult sliders, recipe.age='child' switches it on.
